topic: IDA Headless MCP 2026: Rust-Native Reverse-Engineering with AI Agents

key_points: De-facto standard MCP server for IDA; ~12,000 GitHub stars, 1,400+ forks
Bridges IDA Pro and headless idalib to AI assistants (Claude, etc.) via MCP
Supervisor/worker model: each open database runs in its own idalib worker process
Workers are persistent, outlive the supervisor, and can be adopted by new supervisors
Supports GUI plugin (being deprecated), stdin/stdout transport, and SSE/HTTP headless mode
idb_open with preferred_session_id, idb_close to release workers; idle TTL ~1 hour
Rust-native headless IDA Pro MCP server built on idalib
Exposes 71 MCP tools across core DB, functions, disassembly, Hex-Rays decompile, CFG, memory search, type editing, scripting
Install via Homebrew tap (macOS/Linux) or Scoop bucket (Windows); npx ida-mcp-rs
Requires IDA Pro 9.2/9.3 + Hex-Rays decompiler license for decompile tools
Toolset filtering via IDA_MCP_TOOLSETS / IDA_MCP_EXCLUDE_TOOLS to cut ~10k context tokens to ~2k
Runs without IDA GUI; stdio transport for Claude Code/cursor
Rust-native multi-session headless server: one supervisor + one IDA worker per opened database
Follows ida-pro-mcp public contract for idb_open, idb_list, idb_close and analysis tools
Supports stdio and Streamable HTTP transports
Requires a separately licensed local IDA install
Optional 'unsafe' tools (Python eval, diff helpers) gated for trusted local analysis only
Original 'ida-headless-mcp' open-source project (MIT); ~130-160 stars
Go orchestrator + Python worker per session; 52 MCP tools for binary analysis
Multi-session concurrency via process isolation; automatic 4h session timeouts
Il2CppDumper metadata import for Unity games; unflutter for Flutter/Dart
Runs on HTTP/SSE at localhost:17300
Apache-2.0 MCP server exposing IDA RE tools to LLM clients (headless mode via idalib)
MCPyIDA-headless command prints JSON readiness signal with host/port
Tools: listing, analysis (decompile/disasm/xrefs/CFG), types, modification (rename/set_comment/patch), scripting, search
Prereq IDA Pro 9.x with idalib; needs valid IDA license (does not bundle IDA)

stats.fact: mrexodia/ida-pro-mcp is the dominant IDA MCP server with ~12,000 GitHub stars and ~1,400 forks.
blacktop/ida-mcp-rs (Rust) exposes 71 MCP tools; the full toolset consumes ~10k tokens of context, filterable to ~2k.
zboralski/ida-headless-mcp ships 52 MCP tools and defaults session timeouts to 4 hours (configurable), paginating up to 1000 results.
ida-mcp-rs supports up to ~100 concurrent analysis sessions with zero external dependencies (Rust coordinator + C++ idalib workers).
Headless operation requires idalib (IDA-as-a-library), available from IDA Pro 9.0+/Essential 9.2+; IDA is commercial licensed software.
MCP (Model Context Protocol) standardizes AI agents discovering/invoking tools via JSON-RPC over stdio, SSE, or Streamable HTTP.

angles: Rust-native IDA headless MCP servers are the 2026 trend: single static binary, no Python runtime, one supervisor + one IDA worker per database
Headless idalib lets AI agents drive IDA without the GUI — enabling automated reverse engineering in CI and bulk malware triage
Concurrency and process isolation are the differentiators: multi-session, persistent workers, session adoption, and auto timeouts
Toolset filtering to control MCP context overhead (<10k -> ~2k tokens) is a practical optimization for tight-context clients
Licensing reality: idalib + Hex-Rays decompiler require paid IDA licenses even though the MCP servers are open source
The 'vibe reversing' workflow: natural-language decompilation/xref/string/rename commands to Claude/Cursor without touching the IDA UI
